dialogues.speaker: Miss Bu
dialogues.text: Why, the legend of the conch lodge. It's very popular among the young people of Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Miss Bu
dialogues.text: ...You can hear the sound of the sea in a conch shell. The same is true of the conch lodge...

dialogues.speaker: Miss Bu
dialogues.text: Only, the sounds heard here come not from the ocean blue... but from the Sea of Souls.

dialogues.speaker: Miss Bu
dialogues.text: If somebody hears sounds from the conch lodge, it could well mean that—

dialogues.speaker: Miss Bu
dialogues.text: Sorry! I didn't mean to scare you...
